Each contains byte-preserved scenario/recording/commands JSON and both complete

No server or Godot process generated new outcomes during this copy.

The original Blindness application omits effect identity; only its actual cast
supplies it. That audience-local cast is Amber60 / Blue61, not a shared event ID.
These are four recorded option identities, not recordings of all seventeen
typed options. Deafness finite art remains missing; a condition marker is a
separate existing source. Native pixels and visual acceptance are unqualified.
